name: fig34_generalized_entropy_branches
caption: Phenomenological island toy model S_gen(u) = S_H(1 + mu u) + S_rad exp(-u/xi) with S_H = S0 (1-tau)^(2/3) and S_rad = r (S0 - S_H); parameters S0 = 1000, r = 1.333, mu = 1, xi = 0.05. (a) The island candidate is a minimum of S_gen in u (dots). (b) The entropy of the radiation is the smaller of the no-island and island branches; the switch at tau_P = 0.6203 is a kink, i.e. a first-order-like transition. (c) After tau_P the radiation entropy follows the black-hole entropy. The functional form and parameters are illustrative assumptions, not derived from gravity.
